instantiiif-desc: MediaWiki Foreign FileRepo that hotlinks images from IIIF sources (Presentation API v2/v3).
iiif-unresolved: Could not resolve IIIF image for this file.
instantiiif-inspect-intro: Paste a IIIF Presentation API v2 or v3 manifest URL to preview exactly what InstantIIIF extracts from it. Useful when adding a new provider or debugging missing metadata.
instantiiif-inspect-url-help: An absolute HTTP(S) URL to a IIIF Presentation API v2 or v3 manifest (e.g. https://iiif.arthistoricum.net/proxy/fotothek/df_dk_0007450/manifest.json).
instantiiif-inspect-provider-help: Optional. Pick the provider ID this manifest belongs to so InstantIIIF can apply its provider-specific metadata fallbacks (landing-URL / license-URL extraction).
instantiiif-inspect-fetch-failed: Could not fetch a usable IIIF manifest from $1. Check that the URL is reachable from this server, returns JSON, and doesn't carry an error envelope.
